fusions.name: Draw It Back Out
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions. A sting that deals 8 damage, draws your afflictions back out of the target and adds 0.6 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: No Known Cure
fusions.desc: Stings every enemy within 3 tiles. Each sting deals 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaves its target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Returned Dose
fusions.desc: Raises a ward for 10 seconds: each condition laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it.

fusions.name: Immune to Its Own
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 12% poison resistance.
